instances.instructions: List ONLY the missing NEW executable part instances required by the utterance. Reuse the current graph and the library first: each existing library key can add one instance with its exact label and kind. Do not return those reusable instances. Return extra instances only for unavailable requested names/kinds or multiplicity beyond that capacity. Preserve each requested display name exactly. Do not return edges, parents, operators, existing nodes or invented extras. For identical label/kind missing instances, occurrence is consecutive 1,2,3 within this returned list; it is not a graph ID. Use the existing supported kinds. Return an empty list if no safe missing part is identifiable.
